description: Start a build upload and get signed links that upload the file without an API key: run the returned command in a shell, or PUT each part and POST complete to the links. The build is then checked and ready to run. For AI agents: tool arguments cannot carry a build, so hand the bytes to a shell command. command downloads the command-line tool and uploads the file (parts, then complete). Without it: PUT the raw bytes of part n (partBytes each, the last one shorter) to partUrlTemplate with {partNumber} replaced, then POST {parts: [{partNumber, etag}]} to completeUrl. The links expire at expiresAt and work only for this upload. Call find_build first to skip uploading a file that is already there.

fingerprint.description: Native fingerprint to store with the build, for find_build (optional)

label.description: A label, for example the commit (optional)

name: create_build_upload
title: Create signed upload links
